title: Gravitational Waves Found 390 Black Holes We Could Not See
hook: We found 390 black hole mergers by listening to gravity, not light.
closing: A new way to detect black holes changed what we can count and could expose far more hidden objects.
question: How many black holes remain hidden?

segments.say: Detectors logged 390 black hole mergers, revealing collisions that ordinary telescopes could not show us directly.
Gravitational waves found 390 black holes, turning gravity into a discovery tool for objects that light often misses.
The Milky Way estimate reaches 100 million black holes, so the confirmed catalog may represent only a tiny fraction.
